title: Inversion — Rarely have we...
examples: Rarely have we seen such progress.
Never have I heard a more compelling argument.
Not only did she outline the plan, but she also answered every question.
pattern: Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + main verb
explanation: In formal English, negative adverbs at the start of a sentence trigger inversion: the auxiliary comes before the subject.
explanationIt: In inglese formale, gli avverbi negativi all'inizio della frase causano l'inversione: l'ausiliare precede il soggetto.
realUse: Rarely have we seen such a compelling case.
Never before has the board approved a change so quickly.
Not only does register matter, but nuance does too.

options: Rarely have we seen such progress.
Rarely we have seen such progress.
Rarely have seen we such progress.
We rarely have seen such progress.
exercises.answer: Rarely have we seen such progress.
